### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: When reporting patient denials, list only specific symptoms explicitly denied; avoid generalizing denials (e.g., 'no other unusual symptoms') unless the patient explicitly states them.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: When documenting physical exam findings (e.g., tenderness, discomfort), explicitly link them to the specific maneuver or test where they were observed; do not generalize findings across multiple tests unless explicitly stated.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report the explicit outcomes of diagnostic tests (e.g., 'negative', 'positive', 'reduced') precisely as stated; do not invent findings or contradict explicit results.
